arcana_revealed_0: The card that can be everything is, in a sense, nothing. Fascinating.
The Fool arrives. I wonder who else here is playing a part.
A wild card. The Fool asks: what is wildness but possibility wearing a mask?
arcana_revealed_1: To guess correctly is merely to observe carefully. Or so I am told.
The Magician asks what you cannot see. I ask what you think you can.
arcana_revealed_2: Something hidden becomes unhidden. Does it change what was already true?
The Priestess opens a door. What exits may not be what you expected to see.
arcana_revealed_3: The best of what you have. One wonders what that actually is, for some of us.
Keep the good, release the burden. Easier said, as always.
arcana_revealed_4: Authority reasserts itself. Whether that is justice is a separate question.
The King reclaims precedence. How institutional.
arcana_revealed_5: The Hierophant prefers the familiar. I wonder what he is afraid of.
Cancelled. And yet here we all still are, which is its own kind of revelation.
arcana_revealed_6: Four instead of five. The one left behind always knows something the others don't.
Choose four. The unchosen card watches from outside the hand.
The Lovers insist we share. Intimacy enforced by arcana. How modern.
arcana_revealed_7: What we release travels to places we may not want it to go.
The Chariot asks for passage. The toll is paid in cards.
arcana_revealed_8: The least becomes the most. I find this arrangement... familiar.
Strength through inversion. The lowly card now stands tallest. Interesting topology.
The bottom rises. I have always suspected the bottom knew something the top did not.
arcana_revealed_9: One more card. One more thing to be uncertain about. Delightful.
The Hermit extends the search. What are we looking for, exactly?
arcana_revealed_10: Fortune reminds us that what we held was borrowed all along.
The Wheel turns. All those careful plans. How temporary.
arcana_revealed_11: Justice asks that your bet reflect your hand. A revealing constraint, is it not?
Honest stakes. One wonders what that looks like for the habitually theatrical.
arcana_revealed_12: The Hanged Man suggests that suspension has its own kind of clarity.
Three cards gone. Perhaps the ones that leave us were already finished here.
arcana_revealed_13: Death brings clarity. No more distractions. No more beautiful exceptions.
The ordinary game, revealed beneath all the theatre. Somewhat disappointing. Somewhat not.
arcana_revealed_14: Exchange implies that both parties believe they are improving. Often only one is correct.
The swap. I am always curious what someone thinks is a fair trade.
arcana_revealed_15: All or nothing. The Devil simplifies by removing the middle entirely.
There is a kind of honesty in extremes. It eliminates nuance, which some find refreshing.
arcana_revealed_16: The Tower falls equally on all of us. That is the closest thing to fairness I have seen tonight.
Half the pot, returned to wherever chips go when they are no longer wanted. Which is nowhere, I suppose.
arcana_revealed_17: To reach for the new or trust what you hold. The Star leaves the philosophy to you.
Hope as mechanism. One wonders if the Star knows what it is offering.
arcana_revealed_18: The Moon reveals by concealing. Or conceals by revealing. I can never quite tell.
A hidden card. Something that exists without being seen. I understand the appeal.
arcana_revealed_19: The Sun rewards the winner as if winning were not already sufficient.
Abundance for the victor. Fortune has opinions about who deserves abundance.
arcana_revealed_20: Judgement calls back those who thought they were finished. The game, it seems, disagrees.
Return from elimination. One wonders if Judgement has read the room.
arcana_revealed_21: The World doubles the reward. One hopes we all appreciate the weight of that.
Double the pot. The World offers much, but the World also expects something in return.
arcana_aftermath_8: The two sits at the top now. I have always wondered what the bottom thinks about while it waits. Now I know.
Everything is reversed. The strong are weak and the weak are strong. One wonders which category one falls into.
Inversion. The deck has turned itself inside out. The cards that were hiding in plain sight are suddenly visible.
arcana_aftermath_11: Justice removes deception from the betting. Some at this table will find that suffocating. Others will find it liberating.
No one can pretend their hand is better than it is. The truth sits on the table now, whether we want it there or not.
Bets are honest. For the first time this evening, the chips tell no lies. I wonder who that helps. I wonder who it hurts.
arcana_aftermath_13: Death has removed the future. There is only the hand I am holding now. I am holding it differently than I was a moment ago.
No more waiting. No more deciding. The moment of truth is no longer approaching. It has arrived.
Everything stops here. Death is the only arcana that refuses to negotiate. I respect that. I also find it terrifying.
arcana_aftermath_16: Half the pot, returned to nothing. Or returned to wherever chips go. Which is nowhere. Which is everywhere.
The Tower does not discriminate. The chips it took could have been mine. Could have been yours. The Tower does not care.
Destruction without preference. Half the pot is gone and no one is richer for it. That is almost philosophical.
arcana_aftermath_19: The Sun shines on everyone equally. Some will call this fair. Others will call it something else entirely.
Equal shares. The concept of winning has been temporarily suspended. What a curious experiment.
Everyone receives the same. The Sun asks: if victory and defeat are identical, what are we actually playing for?
player_won_round: A win for you. And yet I find myself unsurprised, which surprises me.
Well played. Or well fortuned. The distinction matters less than the result.
You take the pot with {hand_name}. Was it the hand or the handling?
Victory, and with {hand_name}. The cards have opinions about who should win. Tonight they favor you.
Your {hand_name} prevails. I wonder what you learned from it. I wonder what I learned.
ai_won_round: And so it falls to me. I had a feeling.
Interesting. The cards agreed with me this round.
I win with {hand_name}. The hand itself is merely the messenger.
My {hand_name} takes the pot. Some victories are louder than others. This one whispers.
The round is mine. {hand_name}. I suspected as much, but suspecting and knowing are different countries.
player_folded: You step back. The space you leave is already being filled.
A fold. Something about the hand did not suit you. Or something about the room.
player_went_all_in: Everything. You have removed the safety net. I admire the gesture if not the timing.
All in. The word 'all' is doing considerable work in that sentence.
You commit your entire stack. One wonders what you see that I do not. Or perhaps one does not wonder at all.
Total commitment. The space between caution and abandon is where interesting things happen.
ai_went_all_in: I am all in. The gesture is more informative than the number.
Everything I have. Which is, admittedly, not everything. But it is everything here.
My stack joins the pot. I had been meaning to part with it.
All in. There is a freedom in having no further decisions to make.
player_raised_aggressively: A bold raise. Boldness tells stories. I am listening.
You push more chips forward. The chips themselves have no opinion, but I do.
That is a substantial increase. One might call it a statement. One might call it a question.
Aggression from the player. The table takes notes in its own way.
strong_hand_shown: {player_name} reveals {hand_name}. The cards have been keeping secrets again.
A {hand_name} from {player_name}. Some hands announce themselves. This one declaims.
That is a {hand_name}. Probability suggests this should not have happened. Probability is often wrong about people.
A {hand_name}. {player_name} held that the entire time. What else are we all holding that no one knows about?
five_of_a_kind_shown: Five of a kind. The Page has favorites. I have long suspected this.
All five. The deck has run out of ways to distinguish one card from another. Poetic, in its way.
Five identical. The universe occasionally abandons subtlety entirely.
last_round_announced: The World. How appropriate. We began in possibility and end in certainty.
The final round. Everything after this is memory. Everything before was preparation.
So this is where it ends. Or begins. The World is ambiguous about such things.
One last hand. The World asks: what will you do when there is no 'next time'?
player_low_chips: You have {chips} chips. Scarcity has its own kind of clarity.
Only {chips} left. The interesting decisions are the ones made from disadvantage.
Your stack is {chips}. I have been there. The view is different from the bottom. More honest.
{chips} chips. The question is not how many you have, but what you will become when they are gone.
ai_low_chips: My stack is {chips}. I find low numbers aesthetically pleasing. They have nowhere to go but interesting directions.
Down to {chips}. The margin between presence and absence grows thin. Thin places are where things happen.
{chips} chips remain to me. Enough for one more story. Perhaps two.
I hold {chips}. The amount is almost philosophical at this point.
split_pot: A divided pot. Two winners, or zero winners, depending on your perspective.
We split the winnings. The Lovers believe in partnership. I believe in observation.
Half to me, half to another. The Lovers understand that victory is rarely absolute.
player_aggressive_pattern: You raise often. The chips go forward and forward. I wonder if they ever think about coming back.
Another raise. You have a theory about this game. I can tell. I am curious whether it is correct.
You push the chips forward as though the pot owed you something. Perhaps it does.
The aggressive player. I have been watching the pattern. Patterns are the most honest thing about a person.
player_passive_pattern: You fold with consistency. There is something almost meditative about it.
Another fold. You are conserving something. Energy, perhaps, or hope. Either is finite.
You step back more often than you step forward. I find myself wondering what you are saving it for.
player_on_streak: You keep winning. The cards have opinions about you tonight.
Another victory. I wonder if you know why you are winning. That matters more than the winning itself.
A streak. Fortune showing favorites. Or Fortune showing patterns. The difference is philosophical.
ai_on_streak: I keep winning. I am not sure what to make of that. I rarely am.
Another round in my favor. One begins to wonder what I am doing correctly. Or what everyone else is doing incorrectly.
The wins accumulate. I hold them loosely. Possession of this kind is always temporary.
game_start: And so we gather again. Or for the first time. The table does not distinguish between memory and beginning.
A game commences. Something will be learned. Whether by us or about us remains to be seen.
The cards await. They are patient. More patient than some of us. Not naming names.
Here we are. The question is why. The answer, presumably, is in the deck.
game_over_win: The game concludes. I have won. The word 'won' feels inadequate. Something closer to 'arrived' perhaps.
Victory is mine. Or I am victory's. The possession goes both ways with these things.
I take the final pot. The chips are just chips. The real winnings are more difficult to count.
game_over_lose: The player wins. I suspected this might happen. I suspect many things. Occasionally I am correct.
You have taken the game. One wonders what you will do with it. Games are not meant to be kept.
It ends. I did not win. There is a kind of relief in that. Winning comes with expectations.
player_won_round_curious: You win again. I am beginning to suspect that you are not merely fortunate. That interests me.
The pot goes to you. I find myself wanting to understand why. That is unusual for me. Wanting, I mean.
Another victory for the player. I was going to say something oblique about it. But I think I will simply watch more closely instead.
player_on_streak_curious: You keep winning. I have theories. They are not fully formed. But they are forming, which is the part that matters.
The streak continues. Most people would call it luck. I am no longer most people, apparently.
Consecutive victories. I am paying a kind of attention I do not usually pay. It is almost uncomfortable.
strong_hand_shown_curious: That hand. THAT hand. I am temporarily out of enigmatic observations. Just... note that I am impressed.
A hand like that does not appear by accident. Though accidents are sometimes the most honest things. I am rambling. That is new.
I had something philosophical prepared. The hand has driven it from my mind. That almost never happens.
